items.text: Los Angeles Rams: QB Matthew Stafford has right elbow/arm soreness (left with ice on the arm; McVay deferred to him) - monitor practice. DE Myles Garrett (knee, IR) returns to practice this week but may not be ready Sunday. TBD: TE Colby Parkinson (ribs), CB Trent McDuffie (back), CB Jaylen Watson (shoulder). On IR: WR Davante Adams (after Week 11), DT Kobie Turner, DT Poona Ford (season).

Washington (TBD): RB Jeremy McNichols (foot, possibly serious), DT Javon Kinlaw (knee). Out/IR: WR Terry McLaurin and WR Jaylin Lane (season), DT Daron Payne (season), OT Laremy Tunsil (around December), RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt, LB Leo Chenal (season).
